candidate_operations.source_description: A dated, witnessed, bounded field record of the time-varying gate response at Ashen Gate. It makes forbidden_passage_observed eligible.
candidate_operations.source_commit_condition: Only if delivered prose shows Leyra choosing seal_bounded_report and completing the witnessed record with the stated limits.

candidate_operations.source_description: An authorized follow-up exterior survey becomes possible without the passage being declared safe or reopened.
candidate_operations.source_commit_condition: Only if the bounded record is completed and Ilyan or the guild reviews it in prose.

candidate_operations.source_description: Greyfen gains a concrete, carefully worded reason to monitor the old boundary.
candidate_operations.source_commit_condition: Only in the seal_bounded_report branch, where the careful wording is delivered to the reeve.

candidate_operations.source_description: Leyra's professional trust with Master Ilyan shifts according to how she handled incomplete evidence and how he reacted when she raised the mark.
candidate_operations.source_commit_condition: Only if the prose shows the review at Vellum Hall and Ilyan's reaction.

candidate_operations.source_description: Ilyan's private mark is noted at the exterior stone as evidence of prior presence only.
candidate_operations.source_commit_condition: Only if the prose shows Leyra finding and recording it, with no motive or cause attached.
